name: flyrank-context
title_zh: 面试前先读的公司内部背景卡，专治「这题在考啥」
tagline_zh: 面试官提到「旗子」「打败规则」时你一脸懵？这份背景把产品、搜索难题、手写旗子的来龙去脉一次讲清，让你接得住话茬。
tagline_en: Blank when interviewer says 'flags' or 'beat the rule'? This background briefs you on the product, the search.
desc_en: FlyRank-specific background — what the company does, the search problem, and the hand-written flags story that the ML internship work builds on. Load for context when an assignment references FlyRank's product, flags, or the "beat the rule" framing. (Project-specific: delete this folder when reusing the skill library elsewhere.)
why_zh: 它不教算法，只补上下文——把散在代码和文档里的公司叙事收拢成一份面试前能读完的底稿。
why_en: It doesn't teach algorithms—it consolidates the company narrative scattered across code and docs into a pre-interview brief, so.
limit_zh: 只适用于 FlyRank 的 ML 实习生面试语境；不含任何技术题解或算法推导，离开这家公司或这个岗位，内容即失效。
limit_en: Only for FlyRank ML internship interview context; no technical solutions or algorithm derivations. Useless outside this company or role.
title_en: Company context card for FlyRank interview prep
